findings.title: The newly pinned twelve-report unit is applied to only 27 of v14's 80 required coverage keys. The 48 rideless schema-derived keys stay scoped to the clean cell, so the eight offline and upgrade reports carry fixtureClassCoverage arrays that v14 declares report-invalid.

theClosedMap.fact: v14 conformanceReport.fixtureMemberMap.discipline opens 'Closed map.' and mapKeyCount is 80. Counted from live bytes, those 80 divide into 10 AT-<n> acceptance-test halves, 17 AT-ARCHIVE-* golden and negative keys, and 53 schema-derived keys (v14's schemaRequiresCount 45 plus the named conditionalRequires and scopeNote arms and the TC-NAME.4 split, exactly as its discipline sentence describes).
theClosedMap.requirement: v14 conformanceReport.shape.fixtureClassCoverage states that 'Class-wide stand-ins, missing keys, duplicate keys, or alternative producers are report-invalid' over that closed map, and adds that 'AT-* halves and AT-ARCHIVE-* keys are required members of this array' — an addition to the schema-derived baseline, not a restriction of it.
theClosedMap.rideArithmetic: Of the 53 schema-derived keys, exactly 5 carry a ride (TC-ACCEPT.5, TC-SIG.C-LOCK and TC-BYTE-EXACT.C-LOCK on ID-DEP-P2/DR-111, TC-SIG.C-ENVELOPE on ID-DEP-1+ID-DEP-5/DR-112, TC-BYTE-EXACT.C-CANON on ID-DEP-1). Those same 5 are exactly the ones whose producer is 'none' — verified by set equality. The other 48 are rideless with real producers, distributed TC-NAME 16, TC-PATH 13, TC-ACCEPT 5, TC-DUP 5, TC-BYTE-EXACT 3, TC-CLOSURE 3, TC-SIG 2, TC-METADATA-ONLY 1.
theClosedMap.consequence: v14 conformanceReport.shape.lawfulExemptions states that 'not-applicable and blocked-on-ride are lawful only via the ride recorded on that memberKey.' For all 48 there is no ride, so the only lawful standing in any report is produced with {path, sha256}. There is no lawful omission, no lawful not-applicable, and no lawful does-not-apply-on-this-cell.

whatV4Says: reportUnit.eachReport, the whole of the new per-report completeness rule, reads: 'Every report uses the v14 conformanceReport shape. Every report's fixtureClassCoverage includes every AT-* half required by v14 and all seventeen AT-ARCHIVE-* keys, each standing produced with {path, sha256}. Missing keys are report-invalid and fail this specification.' It enumerates 10 halves plus 17 archive keys, which is 27 of the 80. The remaining 53 are not named.
whatThe51FixturesCover reads 'They supply the clean-cell portion of members 1 and 2' — clean-cell only.

EV-1.suppliedBy reads '51 fixtures on the clean cell; AT-1-ASSEMBLY on every cell; AT-8 / all seventeen AT-ARCHIVE-* keys on every cell.' The archive keys were extended to every cell in this revision; the 51 fixtures were left on the clean cell.
EV-2.suppliedBy reads '51-fixture TC-ACCEPT/TC-DUP on the clean cell; OC-3 on every cell.'

matrixCells.clean.exactByteIntent retains 'the 51-fixture admission results that apply to this emission'. matrixCells.offline.exactByteIntent and matrixCells.upgrade.exactByteIntent retain no fixture admission results at all, and neither cell's activeClasses names a single TC-* class.
The token 'fixtureMemberMap' occurs once in the subject, inside the AT-8 sentence. The tokens 'schema-derived' and '80' occur zero times as a map-size reference.
findings.operativeBite: v4 pins twelve reports and forbids the alternatives by name. That commitment propagates v14's closed-map rule to all twelve. Eight of those twelve — the four offline and four upgrade reports — are specified with no standing for 48 required, unrideable member keys, and the specification affirmatively places their supplier on the clean cell. A run can therefore satisfy every cell passProperty, the top-level passProperty, and every failsIf line in this artifact while emitting eight conformance reports the pinned contract calls report-invalid. That is 8 x 48 = 384 required member standings with no rule. This is the same defect class as CLAUDE-G15H-V2-SF1 and CLAUDE-G15H-V3-SF1 — a pass condition that admits a report-invalid fixtureClassCoverage — on the key set the v3 remedy did not reach.

secondFace.issue: The same sentence is also defective for the AT halves, on either reading of its trailing modifier.
secondFace.readingOne: If 'each standing produced with {path, sha256}' governs both conjuncts, then every report must produce AT-1-TRUSTED-INSTALL, AT-4-NEGOTIATION, AT-5-TRUSTED-INSTALL and AT-6. Live v14 records all four with producer 'none' and expected 'blocked-on-ride'. That reading contradicts v14, contradicts v4's own inactiveOrBlocked sentences and its failsIf line 'AT-1-TRUSTED-INSTALL or AT-5-TRUSTED-INSTALL is reported as install-success', and contradicts doesNot 'Does not activate AT-6, AT-1-TRUSTED-INSTALL, or AT-5-TRUSTED-INSTALL.'
secondFace.readingTwo: If the modifier governs only the seventeen archive keys — the natural reading, since the phrase is lifted verbatim from at8.exactByteIntent — then the five rideless halves get no per-report standing rule, and the artifact's own cell scoping leaves them unproduced where they are not active. Measured against activeClasses: AT-3 is named exactly once in the entire 25960-byte subject, in matrixCells.clean.activeClasses, and has no standing on the offline or upgrade reports although it is rideless with expected refuse:RJ-3; AT-2 is absent from upgrade; AT-5-ASSEMBLY is absent from clean and upgrade, though EV-4's 'Clean and upgrade cells retain the same assembly completeness' arguably reaches it; AT-1-ASSEMBLY is absent from offline but is rescued by EV-1.suppliedBy's 'AT-1-ASSEMBLY on every cell'; AT-4 is absent from upgrade but is rescued by EV-3's per-matrix-cell health requirement.
secondFace.note: Recorded as a second face of the same finding, not a second finding. The root cause is one: the per-report completeness rule was written for the seventeen archive keys and not generalised to the closed 80-key map with its per-member ride and producer facts.

notRescuedBy: reportUnit.eachReport's closing sentence 'Missing keys are report-invalid and fail this specification' does not rescue it. Read narrowly it means the 27 keys the same sentence just enumerated. Read broadly as v14's closed map it requires all 80 on every report, which flatly contradicts whatThe51FixturesCover, EV-1.suppliedBy and EV-2.suppliedBy, all three of which place the fixture supply on the clean cell. The sentence settles nothing either way, and on the broad reading it re-creates inside v4 the same one-thing-said-two-ways defect v4 was written to remove.

EV-1.exactByteIntent's qualifier 'the 51-fixture admission results that apply' does not rescue it. It scopes which results are retained, not which member keys the coverage array must carry. v14 offers no does-not-apply standing: the standing that would express it is not-applicable, and that is unlawful for a rideless member.

The failsIf list does not rescue it. Its coverage guard is 'any of the twelve reports omits any of the seventeen AT-ARCHIVE-* keys, or records any of them class-wide, not-applicable, or blocked-on-ride' — seventeen keys named, the other sixty-three unguarded.
v14 does not rescue it. The map is closed, the coverage array's missing-keys rule is unqualified, and lawfulExemptions leaves a rideless member exactly one standing.
findings.remedyShape: Two honest options, neither of which requires authoring a fixture byte. Either extend the per-report rule to the whole closed map — state in reportUnit.eachReport that every one of the twelve reports carries all 80 fixtureMemberMap keys, that the 48 rideless schema-derived keys and the 5 rideless AT halves are produced with {path, sha256} on every report, and that the 5 rided schema-derived keys and the 5 rided AT halves take their recorded ride — and correct whatThe51FixturesCover, EV-1.suppliedBy and EV-2.suppliedBy so the fixture supply is no longer clean-cell-only; or revisit the report unit itself, since a unit that forces all 48 admission fixtures onto every cell may be the wrong unit, in which case the per-platform alternative must be re-argued against EV-3's per-matrix-cell health record rather than merely forbidden in failsIf. Either way the trailing modifier in reportUnit.eachReport must be disambiguated so it cannot be read as producing the four blocked-on-ride halves. This reviewer selects neither option, authors no fixture bytes, and writes no obligation text.
findings.gradeRationale: Graded SHOULD-FIX and not a blocker because the artifact binds nothing, applies nothing, is CANDIDATE-NOT-APPLIED at DO-NOT-SEAL with gates2and3HoldForDR103 false, and because the report unit it pins is itself a genuine advance. Graded SHOULD-FIX and not advisory because the defect sits in an operative pass condition, conflicts with the pinned contract on the artifact's own chosen reading, and is the unlanded remainder of a defect class raised twice before.

decision.rule: ACCEPT only at 0 blockers and 0 SHOULD-FIX.
decision.recommendation: DO-NOT-SEAL. Do not record. A v5 that applies the twelve-report completeness rule to the whole closed 80-key map — or that re-argues the unit itself — and that disambiguates the trailing 'each standing produced' modifier would, on these bytes, carry no remaining finding known to this reviewer.
decision.summaryForCoordinator: v4 lands CLAUDE-G15H-V3-SF1 for the seventeen AT-ARCHIVE-* keys: the report unit is pinned at twelve with an explicit negative clause and a failsIf guard, and all four previously conflicting scope statements now agree. CLAUDE-G15H-V1-SF1 and the CLAUDE-G15H-V2-SF1 inventory half remain landed. Every mechanical check is clean — subject unmoved at f9d544f5 and 0444, eleven of eleven cited digests equal live bytes, file 08 pin equal to live, HEAD 5d5d778, required-now 26, thirty gate rows, prohibition scan clean. One SHOULD-FIX stands: the new per-report rule reaches only 27 of v14's 80 closed-map keys. The 48 rideless schema-derived keys stay scoped to the clean cell, and since v14 leaves a rideless member exactly one lawful standing, the eight offline and upgrade reports carry coverage arrays the pinned contract declares report-invalid — the same defect class as the two prior findings, on the key set this fix did not reach.
